title: The Christmas Protocol (Jordan Shawn Kelly)
summary: On Christmas night at 414 Geneva Street, the women of the Pact stage a loving intervention to dismantle Megan's lingering age-gap hesitation, inviting her into the king-sized bed with Jordan and officially welcoming her into the Pact on Boxing Day with passionate, zero-jealousy kisses and the No-Privacy Protocol. The next evening, haunted by his time on the CVICU ventilator, Jordan and the family design a permanent Legal & Health Firewall against his mother: a unanimous decision that foundational anchor Aubrie Jean will legally marry Jordan, Mark's gift of his own middle name so Jordan can shed his birth name forever to become 'Jordan Shawn Kelly,' and Hannah's joyous proposal of a Double Wedding with Mark and Hannah.
